page.layout: One page of the scan: a manuscript ownership inscription in ink near the top, with a dark strip of trimmed edge above it. No printed text block. A digitiser's credit line sits at the bottom right.
page.notes: The only writing is handwritten ink, "Buxtorf / Iohann" or similar, which is handwriting and not transcribed. The strip at the top is the edge of the neighbouring page or a cover edge. The bottom-right line is a digitiser's credit and is left out. Specks and stains are not text.
